content:
Ross Coulthart mentioned these Russian areas of advanced research and weapons programs located beneath the facility on Mount Yamantau, and I have found most of that research. Keep in mind that the US and Russia even collaborated on many of those areas. #ufotwitter #uapx

Areas of advanced research that Ross mentioned are:     

-Scalar weapons  
- Free Electron, X-Ray and Gamma Ray lasers  
-Neutrino Beams for communication   
-Relativistic electron beams  
-Ionospheric weapons  
-Compression of ion beams by magnetic fields  
-Magnetic monopole micro black hole factory  
-Weapons based on induced proton decay  
-Micro nuke gravitational wave detectors   

Ross wasn't lying about anything i found that Russian 46th Central Scientific-Research Institute (46 TsNII MO RF) [Ministry of Defense] and Chief BURENOK, Vasiliy Mikhaylovich, Maj-Gen, Dr. Tech Sciences (Voyennaya Mysl, No 9, Sep 03) really do exist. What's interesting this tech-science department is apparently on US-EU sanction list.     

Not only that, but during difficult years because of reforms, the 46th Institute and the Russian Ministry of Defence worked under the control of the Russian intelligence agency, the FSB, in order to protect state secrets.    

Scalar weapons-I don't need to talk too much about Russian Scalar weaponization you can find on my account released CIA files on Russian Scalar weaponization and Russian use since 1960s, George Mason University papers from 2024 titled Scalar Waves Global Destabilizing Force which talks about US, Russia and China there are also The War Zone article on appearance of Dome of Light over Russia in 1987.    

Free-electron lasers, X-ray and gamma lasers – I found many Russian papers and patents about them; information about them is very easily available. For military use, the gamma laser is the most powerful, followed by the free-electron laser. They can be powered by fission or fusion reactors.    

Particle beam weapons are not on Ross list, but they should be, because an American general said that the Russians developed a particle beam weapon in 1977 that uses ICF fusion as an energy source.    

Russian research on neutrinos is the easiest one to find.    

Ionospheric weaponization is the same trough some digging you can find interesting information's and patents.    

I haven't found anything about micro black holes, but from what I understand, they are probably used as energy sources to power spacecraft or used as weapons. If you've been following the latest news and data, you probably know that this is feasible.    

In 2012 Russian Minister of Defence publicly admitted that Russia is creating weapons based on new physical principles like direct energy weapons, geophysical weapons, wave-energy weapons, genetic weapons and psychotronic weapons basically all of those were already made in this time frame 1950s-1970s.    

In the end, I must say that it's not just Russia and the United States; other nations possess this knowledge as well, perhaps a little later than them, but there are still at least a few other countries that can do it.
